scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic: reversibility makes the killed generator self-adjoint and positive definite in the stationary weighted inner product, which yields a positive finite exponential mixture for the time-stationary survival. Its hazard derivative is an exact negative spectral variance, and the event-stationary survival is exactly the normalized derivative of the time-stationary survival. The bundled computation only replays finite-dimensional identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite irreducible MMPPs whose modulating chain is reversible and whose average event rate is positive. It does not settle the conjectured stochastic order for nonreversible modulators. A weighted self-adjoint version of the argument could exist implicitly in older reversible killed-chain or phase-type literature.
title: Reversible modulation resolves the stationary-interarrival order for MMPPs
